commit.message:
wp433 P2c-R: _kiem_dich_ghi coi reparse point (junction, mount point, symlink) la lien ket

Dac ta GWS-CRED-DICH-NGOAI-KHO-R r1 (sha256 4d4b31812788...), lease wp433-r5-g1-claude, Issue #433.

- M1 than `_kiem_dich_ghi`: dong nhan dien thanh `st = os.lstat(tien_to)` va dieu kien
  `stat.S_ISLNK(st.st_mode) or getattr(st, "st_file_attributes", 0) & stat.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT`;
  cum `la lien ket tuong trung`, chi tiet, dong vong, chu ky, thu tu luat, nhanh FileNotFoundError /
  NotADirectoryError giu nguyen; docstring neu ve moi. POSIX khong doi hanh vi (stat_result khong co
  `st_file_attributes`). Ap cho moi nguoi goi (W1-W3, W4/W5, W6) tren dung cac tien to ho truyen.
- M2 fragment wp433_gws_cred_win_reparse: 2 ca / 7 luot (3 + 4), 3 dot bien (2 moi nen, 1 chi nt),
  3 tu kiem phan hang, phan chung bo do `pc_truc_tiep` (moi nen) va `pc_chi_kiem_cfgdir` (nt), so luot
  va danh sach ID viet rieng, `os.lstat` da boc khoi phuc trong `finally` va duoc kiem sau `run`.
- M3: tai sinh scripts/tl_test_fragments_bundled.py bang generate_bundled_module_bytes.

Ca `lien_ket_nt`, dot bien `db_bo_reparse_nt` va `pc_chi_kiem_cfgdir` CHUA chay tren Windows that (do
native §4c do phien dieu phoi chay).

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_015GtxrYN8oeEszoAzSfeQFV

commit.message:
wp433 P2c-R: dot bien 2 cua fragment reparse theo dac ta r1b (mat na mo rong, a = 528)

Dac ta GWS-CRED-DICH-NGOAI-KHO-R r1b (sha256 43d60d7c8fa6...), Issue #433.

Phep thay cu cua `db_reparse_moi_thu` (ve thuoc tinh thanh `!= 0`) chet SAI LUOT tren Windows: `os.lstat`
dat `st_file_attributes` khac 0 cho moi entry that (thu muc 16, goc o 22), nen o luot `W5.bit` vong tien to
chan tai goc o thay vi tai cfgdir. Do: mo phong Linux (moi entry that mang attr 16 => run False) va probe
native tren Desktop do phien dieu phoi chay.

- `db_reparse_moi_thu`: mat na thanh `stat.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT | stat.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_SPARSE_FILE`.
- Luot `W5.khong_bit` gia lap `FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY | FILE_ATTRIBUTE_SPARSE_FILE` (528).
- Tai sinh scripts/tl_test_fragments_bundled.py bang generate_bundled_module_bytes.

`scripts/tl_gws.py` khong doi so voi commit truoc.
